Claim 1 (Currently Amended): A method, comprising: inputting database constructs generated by a database optimizer as an input to a trained machine-learning algorithm; obtaining a database operation predictor from the machine-learning algorithm as an output; modifying at least one of the database constructs based on the database operation predictor producing a modified database construct; and processing a database operation with the modified database construct and at least one other database construct.

Claim 10 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising, storing the database operation predictor in database statistics associated with the modified database construct and the database constructs.

Claim 12 (Currently Amended): A method comprising: training a machine-learning algorithm with database constructs produced by a database optimizer; receiving query execution plans for a query from the database optimizer with a least cost query execution plan identified by the database optimizer for the query; providing the query execution plans as input to the machine-learning algorithm; obtaining as an output a predicted execution time for the query based on the least cost query execution plan; and modifying one of: the least cost query execution plan for the query, a scheduled execution time for the query, and resources that are used to execute the query based on the predicted execution time, wherein the resources include access to one or more execution nodes.

Claim 15 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 12, wherein providing further includes providing the database tool within a workload scheduler and resource management component of a database system.

Claim 18 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 12, wherein modifying further includes changing an execution resource of the least cost query execution plan based on the predicted query execution time, a current performance associated with the execution resource, and workload availability on a resource allocation level. 

Claim 19 (Currently Amended): A system, comprising: a database management system; at least one hardware processor; a non-transitory computer-readable storage medium having executable instructions representing a trained machine-learning algorithm; the machine learning algorithm configured to execute on the at least one hardware processor from the non-transitory computer-readable storage medium and to perform processing to: i) receive as input database constructs produced by a database optimizer for a database operation of the database management system; and ii) provide as output a predicted value relevant to one or more of the database constructs and the database operation; wherein the database management system is configured to process the predicted value to determine whether to modify one of: the one or more database constructs and the database operation before processing the database operation within the database management system.

Claim 20 (Currently Amended): The system of claim 19, wherein the predicted value is an estimated query execution time for a query and the database operation is execution of a query execution plan for the query within the database management system, wherein the system is further configured to inform resource allocation adjustments based on the predicted execution time.
